prompt.text:
The function $f$ is defined by the equation $f ( x )=5 x - 6$. What is the value of $f$
$( x )$ when $x=10$?

A polygon with 22 sides has a perimeter of 131 inches. The length of one side is 5 inches. The
other 21 sides have equal lengths. What is the length, in inches, of one of the 21 sides with equal
lengths?

$$7x-8y=x27x-8y=36$$
A solution to the given system of equations is $(x,y)$, where $x$ is positive. What is the value of $x$?

A real estate company offers a series of three webinars. 3,125 people attended the first webinar.
$56\%$ of the people who attended the first webinar attended the second webinar, and $26\%$ of the
people who attended the first and second webinars attended the third webinar. How many people
attended all three webinars?

The expression $15 x ( x 2+9 )$ is equivalent to a $x 3+b x 2$
$+c x$, where $a$, $b$, and $c$ are constants. What is the value of $a b c$?

In the $xy$-plane, an equation of circle $R$ is $( x+8 ) 2+( y+19 ) 2=100$.
Circle $S$ is obtained by shifting circle $R$ to the right 3 units. An equation defining circle $S$ is $( x$
$+h ) 2+( y+k ) 2=100$, where $h$ and $k$ are constants. What is the value of $h$?

In triangle $JKL$, the measures of $K$
$$\angle$$
and $L$
$$\angle$$
are each 51. What is the measure of $J$, in
$$\angle$$
degrees?
(Disregard the degree symbol when entering your answer.)
If $16+\frac{1}{4} ( 7 x - 6 )=\frac{3}{4} ( 7 x - 6 )$. what is the value of $7 x - 6$?

$$8x-7y=54x+y=8$$
The solution to the given system of equations is $(x,y)$. What is the value of $x+y$?

$$0.10x+0.20y=0.17(x+y)$$
The equation gives a volume $x$, in gallons, of a $10\%$ saltwater solution that could be mixed with a
volume $y$, in gallons, of a $20\%$ saltwater solution to produce a $17\%$ saltwater solution. According
to this equation, what volume, in gallons, of the $20\%$ saltwater solution could be mixed with 75.0
gallons of the $10\%$ saltwater solution to produce a $17\%$ saltwater solution?
(Assume that the volume of the mixture is the sum of the volumes of the two solutions before
they were mixed.)

The quadratic function $g$ models the depth, in meters, below the surface of the water of a Weddell
seal $t$ minutes after the seal entered the water during a dive. The function estimates that the seal
reached its maximum depth of 382.2 meters 7 minutes after it entered the water and then reached
the surface of the water 14 minutes after it entered the water. Based on the function, what was the
estimated depth, to the nearest meter, of the seal 10 minutes after it entered the water?

$$r2+qr=8r-87$$
In the given equation, $q$ is an integer constant. The given equation has no real solutions. What is
the largest possible value of $q$?
